content.text: That's everything I need. Here is the spec - please check it before I write the script.

spec.title: Monthly sales summary per shop
spec.summary: Combine the monthly sales exports of all shops into one workbook with invoices, units and revenue per shop and month, plus totals per shop and a grand total.

inputs.description: One sales export per shop and month; shop name in the file name.

steps: Read every sales file and take the shop name from the file name.
Map the Station headers (Sale Date, Invoice, Item, Quantity, Price, Amount) to the standard names.
Drop empty rows and the TOTAL row.
Parse text dates in day.month.year format.
Derive Month (YYYY-MM) from the sale date.
Aggregate invoices, units and revenue per shop and month, and per shop.
Add an 'All shops' grand-total row to the shop totals.
business_rules: Invoices = number of distinct invoice numbers, excluding refunds.
Refunds are invoice numbers ending in -R<number>; they have negative quantities and reduce Units and Revenue.
Revenue = sum of Line Total, rounded to 2 decimals.
Month comes from the sale date, not from the file name.
Shop names are title case (North, Harbour, Station).
edge_cases: Harbour files end with a TOTAL row that must be ignored.
North files contain completely empty rows.
Station files use different column names and text dates.
A shop with only refunds in a month gets 0 invoices.

schedule.notes: After all shop files for the month arrive.

input.code:
import re

import pandas as pd

# The shops' tills export different header names; map them to one vocabulary.
HEADER_ALIASES = {
    "date": "Date",
    "sale date": "Date",
    "invoice no": "Invoice No",
    "invoice": "Invoice No",
    "product": "Product",
    "item": "Product",
    "qty": "Qty",
    "quantity": "Qty",
    "unit price": "Unit Price",
    "price": "Unit Price",
    "line total": "Line Total",
    "amount": "Line Total",
}
REQUIRED = ["Date", "Invoice No", "Product", "Qty", "Line Total"]
FILE_NAME = re.compile(r"sales_(?P<shop>[A-Za-z]+)_(?P<month>\d{4}-\d{2})")
REFUND = re.compile(r"-R\d+$")


def _read(path):
    if path.suffix.lower() == ".csv":
        return pd.read_csv(path)
    return pd.read_excel(path)


def _load_shop_file(path):
    match = FILE_NAME.search(path.stem)
    if match is None:
        raise ValueError(f"{path.name}: expected a file name like sales_<shop>_<YYYY-MM>.xlsx")
    frame = _read(path)
    frame = frame.rename(
        columns=lambda c: HEADER_ALIASES.get(str(c).strip().lower(), str(c).strip())
    )
    missing = [c for c in REQUIRED if c not in frame.columns]
    if missing:
        raise ValueError(f"{path.name}: missing columns {missing}")

    # Blank rows (North) and the TOTAL row (Harbour) have no invoice number.
    frame = frame.dropna(how="all")
    frame = frame[frame["Invoice No"].notna()]
    frame = frame[frame["Product"].astype(str).str.strip().str.upper() != "TOTAL"].copy()

    # Station exports dates as text in day.month.year format.
    if not pd.api.types.is_datetime64_any_dtype(frame["Date"]):
        frame["Date"] = pd.to_datetime(frame["Date"].astype(str).str.strip(), format="%d.%m.%Y")

    frame["Qty"] = pd.to_numeric(frame["Qty"])
    frame["Line Total"] = pd.to_numeric(frame["Line Total"])
    frame["Invoice No"] = frame["Invoice No"].astype(str).str.strip()
    frame["Shop"] = match["shop"].title()
    frame["Month"] = frame["Date"].dt.strftime("%Y-%m")
    # Refunds reduce units and revenue but are not counted as invoices.
    frame["Is Refund"] = frame["Invoice No"].str.contains(REFUND)
    return frame[["Shop", "Month", "Invoice No", "Qty", "Line Total", "Is Refund"]]


def _aggregate(lines, keys):
    invoices = lines[~lines["Is Refund"]].groupby(keys)["Invoice No"].nunique()
    grouped = lines.groupby(keys).agg(Units=("Qty", "sum"), Revenue=("Line Total", "sum"))
    grouped.insert(0, "Invoices", invoices)
    grouped["Invoices"] = grouped["Invoices"].fillna(0).astype(int)
    grouped["Units"] = grouped["Units"].astype(int)
    grouped["Revenue"] = grouped["Revenue"].round(2)
    return grouped.reset_index()


def run(input_paths, output_path):
    lines = pd.concat([_load_shop_file(p) for p in input_paths], ignore_index=True)

    summary = _aggregate(lines, ["Shop", "Month"]).sort_values(["Shop", "Month"])
    totals = _aggregate(lines, ["Shop"]).sort_values("Shop")
    grand_total = pd.DataFrame(
        [
            {
                "Shop": "All shops",
                "Invoices": int(totals["Invoices"].sum()),
                "Units": int(totals["Units"].sum()),
                "Revenue": round(float(lines["Line Total"].sum()), 2),
            }
        ]
    )
    totals = pd.concat([totals, grand_total], ignore_index=True)

    with pd.ExcelWriter(output_path, engine="openpyxl") as writer:
        summary.to_excel(writer, sheet_name="Summary", index=False)
        totals.to_excel(writer, sheet_name="Shop Totals", index=False)
input.notes: Normalise headers per shop, drop blank and TOTAL rows, then aggregate.
